about: Known answers for the metadata lanes' known-answer control (meta/controls.mjs): facts about our own repository that do not change (ids, creation times, first published versions), or only grow (release count). exact: equal; at_least: a number no smaller; contains: these elements are in the observed list. meta-registry facts come only from entries in the subject owner's own io.github namespace, and only the expected npm package is compared.
subject: isokron-ai/mcp-check
